entities.summary: Nasrollah Moein Najafabadi, known professionally as Moein, is an Iranian pop and traditional music singer based in Los Angeles. He began his musical career at the age of 18, training under renowned artists such as Taj Esfahani and Hassan Kasaei. His first official song, Yeki Ra Doost Midaram, released in 1978, brought him widespread fame.
